CustomField.label: Offer expiry (last valid day)
CustomField.description: SCRUM-467: the last valid day of the offer, computed at read = Offer valid until if recorded, else Offer sent on + 30 days. Blank = no offer recorded. System-computed, never written.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(Offer_Sent_On__c), IF(ISBLANK(Offer_Valid_Until__c), null, Offer_Valid_Until__c), IF(ISBLANK(Offer_Valid_Until__c), Offer_Sent_On__c + 30, Offer_Valid_Until__c))
